tables.name: admin_model_assignments
tables.owner_query: SELECT rowid AS rid,account_id,tenant_id FROM admin_model_assignments
tables.key_transition: Installation authority over a verified shared connection. Exclude this row from personal knowledge archives and clear it on quarantined restore.
tables.verification: Check the account and exact verified provider revision/model/effort foreign keys. Require a current administrator to reassign after migration.
tables.on_failure: Keep the assignment unavailable until an administrator reviews it.
